I don't have any notes for you yet, because I couldn't read a single source. My first attempt to open several commentary pages at once hit the tool's usage limit. A retry with just Enduring Word was then refused because I'd used up my tool calls for this turn. Nothing from any of the approved sites came through.

You asked me to report only what the pages actually say and to give a URL for every point. That means I can't write verse-by-verse notes from my own knowledge, so I haven't.

**Next time, I'll go one page at a time, starting with:**
- Enduring Word: enduringword.com/bible-commentary/hosea-7/
- Precept Austin: preceptaustin.org (Hosea 7 commentary)
- Bible Hub, for Ellicott, Gill, Pulpit Commentary and Benson on Hosea 7 (Benson is a Methodist voice)
- NET Bible notes on Hosea 7, for modern scholarship
- Haydock on Bible Hub, plus newadvent.org and oca.org, for Catholic and Orthodox readings
- Searches of the Reformed, Baptist, Pentecostal and Lutheran sites, to see where the traditions really differ

**To try again,** send a short message such as "continue" and I'll start fetching. If you'd like to keep each turn small, you could also ask for one part at a time: for example, first the traditional reading of verses 1–8, then 9–16, then the differences between traditions and the other views.
